turnaround_reason: Sarepta cratered from ~$150 in 2024 to the mid-teens after acute liver-failure deaths tied to its DMD gene therapy Elevidys forced a label update and shipment pause to non-ambulatory patients. Q1 2026 blew past estimates (adj EPS $3.16 vs $0.99, rev $730.8M vs $474.3M), a restructuring plus new CEO were announced, and management guides to Elevidys momentum rebuilding in 2H26 into 2027.
bullish_points: Q1 2026 massive beat and RBC notes Elevidys sales stabilizing with costs controlled, giving visibility to near-term cash-flow positivity
Only FDA-approved gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy with a large multi-year eligible population; Japan launch (via Roche) added $40M milestone
Heavy insider buying: 914,804 shares purchased across 12 transactions in last 6 months vs only 7,239 sold
Forward P/E ~8.5 and price recovering hard (+27% 30d, +16% 5d), sitting 15% above its 200d MA in recovering mode
Guidance cut on 2026 was met with a +12.9% stock pop — bad news largely priced
bearish_points: Core overhang is patient deaths from acute liver failure; any additional safety signal in the ongoing enhancement study is thesis-ending
Elevidys safety-enhancement study timeline slipped roughly five months, delaying the key de-risking readout for non-ambulatory patients
Net debt position ($1.06B debt vs $788M cash); revenue and margin data fields incomplete in dossier (yfinance nulls on margins/EBITDA)
Gene-therapy competitive landscape and reimbursement scrutiny remain live risks
catalyst: Sequential recovery in Elevidys sales through 2H26/2027 plus readout from the gene-therapy safety-enhancement study that would clear the path back to non-ambulatory patients
catalyst_timing: 2H 2026 sales inflection; safety study readout slipped ~5 months into 2027
suggested_trade: Starter spot position (small-to-medium). For leverage, small long-dated calls (Jan 2027+) sized as a lottery given binary safety risk. Scale spot on confirmed sales re-acceleration.
key_risk: A fresh Elevidys safety/mortality signal (or a bad safety-study readout) that reinstates shipment restrictions and reprices the franchise
would_skip_if: You cannot stomach binary biotech safety risk, or Elevidys sales fail to stabilize in the next reported quarter
